title: Impact of Brexit on Singapore's Economy and Investments
what_it_is: Impact of Brexit on Singapore's Economy and Investments

sections.label: Brexit impact questions to Finance Minister
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Finance about Brexit's impact on Singapore's economy, Temasek and GIC investments, and mitigating actions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Finance (a) what will be the impact of Brexit on the Singapore economy; and (b) whether the Government will take any action to mitigate any adverse effects on the stock market and the economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Finance what is the short-term and medium-term impact of Brexit on (i) Singapore's economy; (ii) Temasek Holdings' investments; and (iii) Government Investment Corporation of Singapore's investments.

sections.label: Brexit economic and political uncertainties
sections.summary: Brexit's economic and political uncertainties will weigh on the UK, Europe and global economy and likely dampen growth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: But what is of greater concern are the economic and political uncertainties resulting from Brexit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: These uncertainties will weigh on the UK, Europe and the global economy for at least a few years and are likely to dampen growth.

sections.label: MTI growth expectations and risks
sections.summary: MTI does not expect these developments alone to significantly reduce Singapore's growth, unless a European slowdown coincides with other factors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: As of now, MTI does not expect these developments on their own to result in a significant reduction of growth in Singapore over the short term or the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: However, if a European slowdown coincides with other factors, such as a sharper than expected slowdown in China or the US, we will see a more major impact on our economy.

sections.label: Lasting repercussions beyond Europe
sections.summary: Brexit will have lasting economic repercussions beyond Europe, and Singapore will watch developments and prepare for their impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: It will have lasting economic repercussions extending beyond Europe.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: We will continue to watch these developments closely, be prepared for their impact on Singapore and see what lessons might be useful for ourselves.

sections.label: Too early to say investment impact
sections.summary: It is too early to say Brexit's effect on long-term returns for GIC, Temasek and MAS, though it may dampen the medium-term outlook.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: Whether or not Brexit and its impact on the UK and European economies affect our long-term expected returns on investments, both GIC and Temasek and, for that matter, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), it is too early to say.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: My guess is that it will dampen somewhat the outlook over the medium term but it is too early to say what the long-term impact will be.

sections.label: Stronger exchange rate against pound
sections.summary: Singapore has a stronger exchange rate against the pound than at any time in the last 35 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam
sentences.text: In fact, we have got a stronger exchange rate against the pound, compared to any time in the last 35 years.
